reuse.why: Puts the check next to findOrCreateBank in the existing link module and applies it to all five provider handlers through one wrapper, without touching the separate link bodies.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the small per-provider account-id extractor lambdas are repeated at registration.

placement.why: The query lives in accounts/link.ts with the other link data helpers; enforcing it as a decorator at app.method registration works but keeps the rule outside the link functions, so a direct internal call to a linkXxx function would skip it.

scope.why: Only the check, the registration wrapper and tests are added.

maintainability.why: A single guard covers every provider and a new provider just needs wrapping; the decorator indirection at registration is slightly less discoverable than a call inside the link flow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers are registered through guardBankAccountLink, which calls link.assertBankAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, applied to every *-accounts-link handler via guardBankAccountLink in accounts/app.ts.
